entities.summary: Benny Urquidez is an American former professional kickboxer, martial arts choreographer and actor. Nicknamed "The Jet", Urquidez was a non-contact karate competitor who later pioneered full-contact fighting in the United States. He made the transition from point to full-contact karate in 1974, the year of its inception in the US, frequently fighting in bouts where the rules were ambiguous and contrasts in styles were dramatic. Urquidez is also known for once holding the rare achievement of six world titles in five different weight divisions, and remained largely undefeated in his 27-year career.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Benny Urquidez's pioneering work in full-contact karate and his six world titles in five different weight divisions have had a lasting impact on the martial arts community in North America. His achievements paved the way for future generations of fighters and helped shape the modern kickboxing scene.
